comment: The solar wind speed is still elevated at ~500 km/s due to residual coronal hole (CH) effects. Activity is expected to decline during the first forecast interval and there is a chance of further ACTIVE spells whilst solar wind parameters remain enhanced. The coronal mass ejection (CME) from 16-Aug appears to have missed Earth. Throughout the rest of the forecast, activity will slowly return to background levels and overall QUIET conditions are anticipated. Solar activity has been increasing due to an active region on the east limb, so far producing three moderate M-class X-ray flares over the past two days. No Earth-directed CMEs have been observed from these events.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
